violated_contract: A hermetic suite's reserved fixture domain must keep resolving inside the harness when product code gains config-time DNS validation. The developer-webhook SSRF guard (5760363ae5) began resolving webhook targets at configuration time via socket.getaddrinfo; the e2e suite's RFC 6761 'webhook.test' fixture host hit the hermetic network guard, which raised 'Hermetic e2e blocked DNS lookup' and failed every developer-webhook e2e test on main.
canonical_prevention: The hermetic getaddrinfo guard answers reserved .test names with a deterministic public-class address (AF_INET 8.8.8.8 — the same answer the SSRF unit tests stub) without performing a real DNS lookup; real socket connects stay guarded. Harness self-tests pin all four sides: .test resolution succeeds (str and bytes host), the synthesized answer passes assert_public_http_url, non-.test hosts still raise, and a connect to the synthesized IP still fails closed.
